Equation (154) then follows from manipulating this expression.

To conclude the proof, we plug equation (154) into the definition of the KL and log-variance CMCD losses:

ℒKL−CMCD​(v)=𝔼Yv∼ℙ→μ,av​[log⁡d​ℙ→μ,avd​ℙ←ν,bv​(Yv)]=𝔼Yv∼ℙ→μ,av[∫01(−⟨v(Yvt,t),𝔰t(Yvt)⟩+(σ​(t)22−ηt)⟨∇rt(Yvt),𝔰t(Yvt)⟩+σ​(t)22∥∇rt(Yvt)∥2)dt−∫01σ(t)−1⟨v(Yvt,t)+(ηt−σ​(t)22)∇rt(Yvt),d​Wt←⟩−r(Yv1)]+const.,\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle&\textstyle\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{KL-CMCD}}(v)=\mathbb{E}_{Y^{v}\sim\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a^{v}}}\big[\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a^{v}}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b^{v}}}(Y^{v})\big]\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\mathbb{E}_{Y^{v}\sim\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a^{v}}}\Big[\int_{0}^{1}\big(-\langle v(Y^{v}_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y^{v}_{t})\rangle+\big(\tfrac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}-\eta_{t}\big)\,\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y^{v}_{t})\rangle+\tfrac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}\,\|\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t})\|^{2}\big)\,\mathrm{d}t\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad\qquad-\int_{0}^{1}\sigma(t)^{-1}\langle v(Y^{v}_{t},t)+(\eta_{t}-\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2})\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}\rangle-r(Y^{v}_{1})\Big]+\mathrm{const.},\end{split} (156)

where we write Yv:=YY^{v}:=Y and av:=aa^{v}:=a to make the dependency of aa on vv explicit. And

ℒVar−CMCD​(v)=VarYv∼ℙ→μ,av​[log⁡d​ℙ→μ,ad​ℙ←ν,b​(Yv)]=VarYv∼ℙ→μ,av[r0(Yv0)−log𝔼𝒩⁡(0,β02​I)[exp(r0)]−(r1(Yv1)−log𝔼pbase[exp(r1)])+∫01[−⟨v(Yvt,t),𝔰t(Yvt)⟩+(σ​(t)22−ηt)⟨∇rt(Yvt),𝔰t(Yvt)⟩+σ​(t)22∥∇rt(Yvt)∥2]dt+∫01[σ(t)−1(⟨v(Yvt,t)+ηt∇rt(Yvt),d​Wt→⟩−⟨v(Yvt,t)+ηt∇rt(Yvt),d​Wt←⟩)+σ⁡(t)2(⟨∇rt(Yvt),d​Wt→⟩+⟨∇rt(Yvt),d​Wt←⟩)]].\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle&\textstyle\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{Var-CMCD}}(v)=\mathrm{Var}_{Y^{v}\sim\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a^{v}}}\Big[\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b}}(Y^{v})\Big]\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\mathrm{Var}_{Y^{v}\sim\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a^{v}}}\bigg[r_{0}(Y^{v}_{0})-\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{N}(0,\beta_{0}^{2}\mathrm{I})}[\exp(r_{0})]-\big(r_{1}(Y^{v}_{1})-\log\mathbb{E}_{p^{\mathrm{base}}}[\exp(r_{1})]\big)\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad+\int_{0}^{1}\Big[-\langle v(Y^{v}_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y^{v}_{t})\rangle+\big(\tfrac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}-\eta_{t}\big)\,\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y^{v}_{t})\rangle+\tfrac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}\,\|\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t})\|^{2}\Big]\,\mathrm{d}t\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad\quad+\int_{0}^{1}\Big[\sigma(t)^{-1}\big(\langle v(Y^{v}_{t},t)+\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}\rangle-\langle v(Y^{v}_{t},t)+\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}\rangle\big)\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad+\tfrac{\sigma(t)}{2}\big(\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}\rangle+\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y^{v}_{t}),\,\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}\rangle\big)\Big]\bigg].\end{split} (157)

Observe that the terms −log⁡𝔼𝒩⁡(0,β02​I)​[exp⁡(r0)]-\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{N}(0,\beta_{0}^{2}\mathrm{I})}[\exp(r_{0})] and log⁡𝔼pbase​[exp⁡(r1)]\log\mathbb{E}_{p^{\mathrm{base}}}[\exp(r_{1})] are unknown constants that can be removed, because they appear inside of the divergence. This yields the final expression of the log-variance CMCD loss.

C.2 Proof of Prop. 4.2: Crooks fluctuation theorem for exponential tilting

We use the notation of Sec. C.1. We apply Prop. A.1 with the same choices as in Sec. C.1, but in this case we leave the expression explicitly in terms of d​Yt→\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}} and d​Yt←\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}, without assuming that YtY_{t} solves any particular SDE. The expression reads:

log⁡d​ℙ→μ,ad​ℙ←ν,b​(Y)=r0​(Y0)−log⁡𝔼𝒩⁡(0,β02​I)​[exp⁡(r0)]−(r1​(Y1)−log⁡𝔼pbase​[exp⁡(r1)])+∫01σ(t)−2⟨(σ​(t)22+ηt)∇rt(Yt)+v(Yt,t),d​Yt→−(κtYt+(σ​(t)22+ηt)(𝔰t(Yt)+12∇rt(Yt))+12v(Yt,t))dt⟩−∫01σ(t)−2⟨(−σ​(t)22+ηt)∇rt(Yt)+v(Yt,t),d​Yt←−(κtYt+(−σ​(t)22+ηt)(𝔰t(Yt)+12∇rt(Yt))+12v(Yt,t))dt⟩.\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b}}(Y)&\textstyle=r_{0}(Y_{0})-\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{N}(0,\beta_{0}^{2}\mathrm{I})}[\exp(r_{0})]-\big(r_{1}(Y_{1})-\log\mathbb{E}_{p^{\mathrm{base}}}[\exp(r_{1})]\big)\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad+\int_{0}^{1}\sigma(t)^{-2}\big\langle\big(\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}+\eta_{t}\big)\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})+v(Y_{t},t),\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad\qquad\quad\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}-\big(\kappa_{t}Y_{t}+\big(\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}+\eta_{t}\big)\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})+\frac{1}{2}\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\big)+\frac{1}{2}v(Y_{t},t)\big)\,\mathrm{d}t\big\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad-\int_{0}^{1}\sigma(t)^{-2}\big\langle\big(-\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}+\eta_{t}\big)\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})+v(Y_{t},t),\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad\qquad\quad\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}-\big(\kappa_{t}Y_{t}+\big(-\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}+\eta_{t}\big)\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})+\frac{1}{2}\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\big)+\frac{1}{2}v(Y_{t},t)\big)\,\mathrm{d}t\big\rangle.\end{split} (158)

This can be simplified to:

log⁡d​ℙ→μ,ad​ℙ←ν,b​(Y)=r0​(Y0)−log⁡𝔼𝒩⁡(0,β02​I)​[exp⁡(r0)]−(r1​(Y1)−log⁡𝔼pbase​[exp⁡(r1)])+∫01σ(t)−2⟨ηt∇rt(Yt)+v(Yt,t),d​Yt→−d​Yt←⟩+12∫01⟨∇rt(Yt),d​Yt→+d​Yt←⟩−∫01(⟨κtYt,∇rt(Yt)⟩+⟨v(Yt,t),𝔰t(Yt)+∇rt(Yt)⟩OPEN+2​ηt​⟨∇rt​(Yt),𝔰t​(Yt)⟩+ηt​‖∇rt​(Yt)‖2)​d​t.\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b}}(Y)&\textstyle=r_{0}(Y_{0})-\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{N}(0,\beta_{0}^{2}\mathrm{I})}[\exp(r_{0})]-\big(r_{1}(Y_{1})-\log\mathbb{E}_{p^{\mathrm{base}}}[\exp(r_{1})]\big)\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad+\int_{0}^{1}\sigma(t)^{-2}\Big\langle\eta_{t}\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})+v(Y_{t},t),\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}-\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\Big\rangle+\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\Big\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}+\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\Big\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad-\int_{0}^{1}\Big(\langle\kappa_{t}Y_{t},\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle+\langle v(Y_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad+2\eta_{t}\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle+\eta_{t}\|\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\|^{2}\Big)\,\mathrm{d}t.\end{split} (159)

Applying (163) and (164), we obtain that

∫01σ(t)−2⟨ηt∇rt(Yt)+v(Yt,t),d​Yt→−d​Yt←⟩\textstyle\int_{0}^{1}\sigma(t)^{-2}\Big\langle\eta_{t}\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})+v(Y_{t},t),\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}-\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\Big\rangle =−∫01(ηtΔrt(Yt)+∇⋅v(Yt,t))dt,\textstyle=-\int_{0}^{1}\big(\eta_{t}\,\Delta r_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla\cdot v(Y_{t},t)\big)\,\mathrm{dt}, (160)
12​∫01⟨∇rt​(Yt),d​Yt→+d​Yt←⟩\textstyle\frac{1}{2}\int_{0}^{1}\Big\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}+\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\Big\rangle =r1​(Y1)−r0​(Y0)−∫01∂trt​(Yt)​𝑑t,\textstyle=r_{1}(Y_{1})-r_{0}(Y_{0})-\int_{0}^{1}\partial_{t}r_{t}(Y_{t})\,\mathrm{d}t, (161)

and plugging these into the right-hand side of (159) concludes the proof:

log⁡d​ℙ→μ,ad​ℙ←ν,b​(Y)=−log⁡𝔼𝒩⁡(0,β02​I)​[exp⁡(r0)]+log⁡𝔼pbase​[exp⁡(r1)]−∫01(⟨κtYt+2ηt𝔰t(Yt),∇rt(Yt)⟩+⟨v(Yt,t),𝔰t(Yt)+∇rt(Yt)⟩+∂trt(Yt)OPEN+ηt​‖∇rt​(Yt)‖2+ηt​Δ​rt​(Yt)+∇⋅v⁡(Yt,t))​d​t.\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b}}(Y)&\textstyle=-\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{N}(0,\beta_{0}^{2}\mathrm{I})}[\exp(r_{0})]+\log\mathbb{E}_{p^{\mathrm{base}}}[\exp(r_{1})]\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad-\int_{0}^{1}\Big(\langle\kappa_{t}Y_{t}+2\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle+\langle v(Y_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle+\partial_{t}r_{t}(Y_{t})\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad+\eta_{t}\|\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\|^{2}+\eta_{t}\,\Delta r_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla\cdot v(Y_{t},t)\Big)\,\mathrm{d}t.\end{split} (162)
Lemma C.1.

Suppose that YY satisfies the SDE d​Yt→=at​(Yt)​d​t+σ⁡(t)​d​Wt→\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}=a_{t}(Y_{t})\,\mathrm{d}t+\sigma(t)\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}, and that ωt:ℝd→ℝd\omega_{t}:\mathbb{R}^{d}\to\mathbb{R}^{d} is differentiable and that rt:ℝd→ℝdr_{t}:\mathbb{R}^{d}\to\mathbb{R}^{d} twice-differentiable with respect to the position variable and differentiable with respect to the time variable. We have that

∫0T⟨ωt(Yt),d​Yt←⟩−∫0T⟨ωt(Yt),d​Yt→⟩=∫0Tσ(t)2∇⋅ωt(Yt)dt,\textstyle\int_{0}^{T}\langle\omega_{t}(Y_{t}),\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle-\int_{0}^{T}\langle\omega_{t}(Y_{t}),\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle=\int_{0}^{T}\sigma(t)^{2}\,\nabla\cdot\omega_{t}(Y_{t})\,\mathrm{d}t, (163)

and

∫0T⟨∇rt​(Yt),d​Yt←⟩+∫0T⟨∇rt​(Yt),d​Yt→⟩=2​∫0T∇rt​(Yt)∘d​Yt=2​(rT​(YT)−r0​(Y0)−∫0T∂trt​(Yt)​dt),\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle&\textstyle\int_{0}^{T}\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle+\int_{0}^{T}\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle=2\int_{0}^{T}\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\circ\mathrm{d}Y_{t}\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=2\big(r_{T}(Y_{T})-r_{0}(Y_{0})-\int_{0}^{T}\partial_{t}r_{t}(Y_{t})\,\mathrm{d}t\big),\end{split} (164)
Proof.

We have that

∫0T⟨ωt​(Yt),d​Yt←⟩−∫0T⟨ωt​(Yt),d​Yt→⟩\textstyle\int_{0}^{T}\langle\omega_{t}(Y_{t}),\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle-\int_{0}^{T}\langle\omega_{t}(Y_{t}),\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle =[ω⁡(Y),Y]T,\textstyle=[\omega(Y),Y]_{T}, (165)

where [ω⁡(Y),Y]t[\omega(Y),Y]_{t} denotes the quadratic variation. Since by Itô’s lemma,

d→(ωt(Yt))=(∂tωt(Yt)+∇ωt(Yt)⊤at(Yt)+12σ(t)2Δωt(Yt))dt+σ(t)∇ωt(Yt)⊤d​Wt→,\textstyle\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}}\big(\omega_{t}(Y_{t})\big)=\Big(\partial_{t}\omega_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla\omega_{t}(Y_{t})^{\top}\,a_{t}(Y_{t})+\tfrac{1}{2}\,\sigma(t)^{2}\,\Delta\omega_{t}(Y_{t})\Big)\,\mathrm{d}t+\sigma(t)\,\nabla\omega_{t}(Y_{t})^{\top}\,\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}W_{t}}, (166)

we have that

[ω(Y),Y]T=∫0Tσ(t)2∇⋅ωt(Yt)dt\textstyle[\omega(Y),Y]_{T}=\int_{0}^{T}\sigma(t)^{2}\,\nabla\cdot\omega_{t}(Y_{t})\,\mathrm{d}t (167)

The first equality in (164) holds by the fact that

∫0T⟨∇rt​(Yt),d​Yt←⟩+∫0T⟨∇rt​(Yt),d​Yt→⟩=lim|π|→0∑k=0K−1⟨∇rtk+1​(Ytk+1)−∇rtk​(Ytk),Yk+1−Yk⟩:=2​∫0T∇rt​(Yt)∘d​Yt\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle&\textstyle\int_{0}^{T}\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\overleftarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle+\int_{0}^{T}\langle\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t}),\overrightarrow{\mathrm{d}Y_{t}}\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\lim_{|\pi|\to 0}\sum_{k=0}^{K-1}\langle\nabla r_{t_{k+1}}(Y_{t_{k+1}})-\nabla r_{t_{k}}(Y_{t_{k}}),Y_{k+1}-Y_{k}\rangle:=2\int_{0}^{T}\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\circ\mathrm{d}Y_{t}\end{split} (168)

where π=(tk)k=0K\pi=(t_{k})_{k=0}^{K} with 0=t0<⋯<tK=T0=t_{0}<\cdots<t_{K}=T and |π|=maxk=0:K−1|tk+1−tk||\pi|=\max_{k=0:K-1}|t_{k+1}-t_{k}|, and the second equality holds by Itô’s lemma in the Stratonovich formulation. ∎

C.3 Proof of Prop. 4.4: NETS for exponential tilting

We use the notation of Sec. C.1 and Sec. C.2. Define

Ft=log⁡𝔼x∼p1base​[exp⁡(rt​(x))].\textstyle F_{t}=\log\mathbb{E}_{x\sim p^{\mathrm{base}}_{1}}[\exp(r_{t}(x))]. (169)

Since log⁡𝔼pbase​[exp⁡(r1)]−log⁡𝔼𝒩⁡(0,β02​I)​[exp⁡(r0)]=F1−F0=∫01∂tFt​𝑑t\log\mathbb{E}_{p^{\mathrm{base}}}[\exp(r_{1})]-\log\mathbb{E}_{\mathcal{N}(0,\beta_{0}^{2}\mathrm{I})}[\exp(r_{0})]=F_{1}-F_{0}=\int_{0}^{1}\partial_{t}F_{t}\,\mathrm{d}t, we can rewrite equation (61) as

log⁡d​ℙ→μ,ad​ℙ←ν,b​(Y)=−∫01(⟨κtYt+2ηt𝔰t(Yt),∇rt(Yt)⟩+⟨v(Yt,t),𝔰t(Yt)+∇rt(Yt)⟩+∂trt(Yt)OPEN+ηt​‖∇rt​(Yt)‖2+ηt​Δ​rt​(Yt)+∇⋅v⁡(Yt,t)−∂tFt)​d​t.\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b}}(Y)&\textstyle=-\int_{0}^{1}\Big(\langle\kappa_{t}Y_{t}+2\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle+\langle v(Y_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle+\partial_{t}r_{t}(Y_{t})\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad+\eta_{t}\|\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\|^{2}+\eta_{t}\,\Delta r_{t}(Y_{t})+\nabla\cdot v(Y_{t},t)-\partial_{t}F_{t}\Big)\,\mathrm{d}t.\end{split} (170)

Thus, for an arbitrary process YY, using Jensen’s inequality

𝔼⁡[log⁡d​ℙ→μ,ad​ℙ←ν,b​(Y)2]=𝔼[(∫01(⟨κtYt+2ηt𝔰t(Yt),∇rt(Yt)⟩+⟨v(Yt,t),𝔰t(Yt)+∇rt(Yt)⟩+∂trt(Yt)+ηt∥∇rt(Yt)∥2+ηtΔrt(Yt)+∇⋅v(Yt,t)−∂tFt)dt)2]≤𝔼[∫01(⟨κtYt+2ηt𝔰t(Yt),∇rt(Yt)⟩+⟨v(Yt,t),𝔰t(Yt)+∇rt(Yt)⟩+∂trt(Yt)+ηt∥∇rt(Yt)∥2+ηtΔrt(Yt)+∇⋅v(Yt,t)−∂tFt)2dt],\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle\mathbb{E}\big[\log\frac{\mathrm{d}\overrightarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\mu,a}}{\mathrm{d}\overleftarrow{\mathbb{P}}^{\nu,b}}(Y)^{2}\big]\!&\textstyle=\!\mathbb{E}\Big[\Big(\int_{0}^{1}\Big(\langle\kappa_{t}Y_{t}\!+\!2\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle\!+\!\langle v(Y_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})\!+\!\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad+\!\partial_{t}r_{t}(Y_{t})\!+\!\eta_{t}\|\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\|^{2}\!+\!\eta_{t}\,\Delta r_{t}(Y_{t})\!+\!\nabla\cdot v(Y_{t},t)\!-\!\partial_{t}F_{t}\Big)\,\mathrm{d}t\Big)^{2}\Big]\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\leq\mathbb{E}\Big[\int_{0}^{1}\Big(\langle\kappa_{t}Y_{t}\!+\!2\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t}),\,\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle\!+\!\langle v(Y_{t},t),\,\mathfrak{s}_{t}(Y_{t})\!+\!\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\qquad\qquad+\!\partial_{t}r_{t}(Y_{t})\!+\!\eta_{t}\|\nabla r_{t}(Y_{t})\|^{2}\!+\!\eta_{t}\,\Delta r_{t}(Y_{t})\!+\!\nabla\cdot v(Y_{t},t)\!-\!\partial_{t}F_{t}\Big)^{2}\,\mathrm{d}t\Big],\end{split} (171)

and the right-hand side is the PINN (physics informed neural network) NETS loss for exponential tilting.

We provide an alternative derivation. The Fokker-Planck equation corresponding to the process XvX^{v} defined in (13) is:

∂tρt+∇⋅((bσ+v)ρt)=σ22∇⋅∇ρt\textstyle\partial_{t}\rho_{t}+\nabla\cdot((b_{\sigma}+v)\rho_{t})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\nabla\cdot\nabla\rho_{t} (172)

We rewrite bσrb^{r}_{\sigma} as follows:

bσr​(x,t)=κt​x+(σ​(t)22+ηt)​(𝔰t​(x)+∇rt​(x))=κt​x+ηt​(𝔰t​(x)+∇rt​(x))+σ​(t)22​(𝔰t​(x)+∇rt​(x))=:b~r​(x,t)+σ​(t)22​(𝔰t​(x)+∇rt​(x)).\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle b^{r}_{\sigma}(x,t)&\textstyle=\kappa_{t}x+\big(\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}+\eta_{t}\big)\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}(x)+\nabla r_{t}(x)\big)\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\kappa_{t}x+\eta_{t}\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}(x)+\nabla r_{t}(x)\big)+\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}(x)+\nabla r_{t}(x)\big)\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=:\tilde{b}^{r}(x,t)+\frac{\sigma(t)^{2}}{2}\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}(x)+\nabla r_{t}(x)\big).\end{split} (173)

Thus, equation (172) becomes

∂tρt+∇⋅((b~r+v)ρt)=σ22∇⋅((−𝔰t−∇rt)ρt+∇ρt)\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle\partial_{t}\rho_{t}+\nabla\cdot((\tilde{b}^{r}+v)\rho_{t})=\frac{\sigma^{2}}{2}\nabla\cdot\big(\big(-\mathfrak{s}_{t}-\nabla r_{t}\big)\rho_{t}+\nabla\rho_{t}\big)\end{split} (174)

Now we want ρt⋆∝ρtbase​exp⁡(rt)\rho^{\star}_{t}\propto\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}\exp(r_{t}) to fulfill this PDE. We write explicitly

ρt⋆​(x)=ρtbase​(x)​exp⁡(rt​(x))Ft,F^t=𝔼y∼ρtbase​[exp⁡(rt​(y))].\textstyle\rho^{\star}_{t}(x)=\frac{\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}(x)\exp(r_{t}(x))}{F_{t}},\qquad\hat{F}_{t}=\mathbb{E}_{y\sim\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}}[\exp(r_{t}(y))]. (175)

Since ∇⋅((−𝔰t−∇rt)​ρt⋆+∇ρt⋆)=0\nabla\cdot\big(\big(-\mathfrak{s}_{t}-\nabla r_{t}\big)\rho^{\star}_{t}+\nabla\rho^{\star}_{t}\big)=0 by construction, we must enforce

0=∂tρt⋆+∇⋅((b~r+v)​ρt⋆)=∂t(ρtbase​(x)​exp⁡(rt​(x))F^t)+∇⋅(b~r+v)​ρt⋆+⟨b~r+v,∇log⁡ρt⋆⟩​ρt⋆=∂t(log⁡ρtbase+rt−log⁡F^t)​ρt⋆+∇⋅(b~r+v)​ρt⋆+⟨b~r+v,𝔰t+∇rt⟩​ρt⋆.\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle 0&\textstyle=\partial_{t}\rho^{\star}_{t}+\nabla\cdot((\tilde{b}^{r}+v)\rho^{\star}_{t})\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\partial_{t}\big(\frac{\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}(x)\exp(r_{t}(x))}{\hat{F}_{t}}\big)+\nabla\cdot(\tilde{b}^{r}+v)\rho^{\star}_{t}+\langle\tilde{b}^{r}+v,\nabla\log\rho^{\star}_{t}\rangle\rho^{\star}_{t}\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\partial_{t}\big(\log\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}+r_{t}-\log\hat{F}_{t}\big)\rho^{\star}_{t}+\nabla\cdot(\tilde{b}^{r}+v)\rho^{\star}_{t}+\langle\tilde{b}^{r}+v,\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle\rho^{\star}_{t}.\end{split} (176)

Since ρtbase\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t} satisfies 0=∂tρtbase+∇⋅((κtx+ηt𝔰t)ρtbase)=∂tρtbase+∇⋅((b~r−ηt∇rt)ρtbase)0=\partial_{t}\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}+\nabla\cdot\big((\kappa_{t}x+\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t})\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}\big)=\partial_{t}\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}+\nabla\cdot\big((\tilde{b}^{r}-\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t})\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}\big), we obtain that

∂tlogρtbase=−∇⋅(b~r−ηt∇rt)−⟨b~r−ηt∇rt,𝔰t⟩.\textstyle\partial_{t}\log\rho^{\mathrm{base}}_{t}=-\nabla\cdot\big(\tilde{b}^{r}-\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}\big)-\langle\tilde{b}^{r}-\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t},\mathfrak{s}_{t}\rangle. (177)

Plugging this into the right-hand side of (176) and using that log⁡F^t=Ft\log\hat{F}_{t}=F_{t} with FtF_{t} defined in (169) yields

0=−∇⋅(b~r−ηt∇rt)−⟨b~r−ηt∇rt,𝔰t⟩+∂trt−∂tFt+∇⋅(b~r+v)+⟨b~r+v,𝔰t+∇rt⟩=∇⋅(v+ηt∇rt)+∂trt−∂tFt+⟨v,𝔰t+∇rt⟩−⟨κt​x+ηt​𝔰t,𝔰t⟩+⟨κt​x+ηt​(𝔰t+∇rt),𝔰t+∇rt⟩=∇⋅(v+ηt∇rt)+∂trt−∂tFt+⟨v,𝔰t+∇rt⟩−⟨κt​x+ηt​𝔰t,𝔰t⟩+⟨κt​x+ηt​(𝔰t+∇rt),𝔰t+∇rt⟩=∇⋅(v+ηt∇rt)+∂trt−∂tFt+⟨v,𝔰t+∇rt⟩+⟨κtx+2ηt𝔰t,∇rt⟩+ηt∥∇rt∥2\textstyle\begin{split}\textstyle 0&\textstyle=-\nabla\cdot\big(\tilde{b}^{r}-\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}\big)-\langle\tilde{b}^{r}-\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t},\mathfrak{s}_{t}\rangle+\partial_{t}r_{t}-\partial_{t}F_{t}+\nabla\cdot(\tilde{b}^{r}+v)+\langle\tilde{b}^{r}+v,\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\nabla\cdot\big(v+\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}\big)+\partial_{t}r_{t}-\partial_{t}F_{t}+\langle v,\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad-\langle\kappa_{t}x+\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t},\mathfrak{s}_{t}\rangle+\langle\kappa_{t}x+\eta_{t}\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\big),\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\nabla\cdot\big(v+\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}\big)+\partial_{t}r_{t}-\partial_{t}F_{t}+\langle v,\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle\quad-\langle\kappa_{t}x+\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t},\mathfrak{s}_{t}\rangle+\langle\kappa_{t}x+\eta_{t}\big(\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\big),\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle\\ \textstyle&\textstyle=\nabla\cdot\big(v+\eta_{t}\nabla r_{t}\big)+\partial_{t}r_{t}-\partial_{t}F_{t}+\langle v,\mathfrak{s}_{t}+\nabla r_{t}\rangle+\langle\kappa_{t}x+2\eta_{t}\mathfrak{s}_{t},\nabla r_{t}\rangle+\eta_{t}\|\nabla r_{t}\|^{2}\end{split} (178)

Thus, for ρt⋆\rho^{\star}_{t} to satisfy the FPE (172), which means that is the law of the marginal XtvX^{v}_{t}, we need vv to satisfy (178). Observe that the terms in the right-hand side of (178) match one to one the terms in the right-hand side of (171). Hence, the NETS loss can be interpreted as a PINN loss on the residual of (178).
